text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 106,689 to 93,501, so I should make sure my overall stock exposure fits my risk tolerance rather than judging each holding in isolation.","Because past price changes do not predict future changes, I should not treat this decline as a signal about what happens next or trade just to react to it.","Before holding through further swings, I should review whether my allocation is diversified and keep enough cash for my needs; any changes should follow a plan, not short-term performance."]}
